zh: 给第 i 个栈里的每枚代币赋权值 2 的 i 次方：拿走两枚、下一栈加一枚，总权值不变，而代币数减少 1。
只要某个栈至少有 2 枚就还能继续操作；最终每个栈至多 1 枚，这正是总权值的二进制表示，所以最少代币数就是总权值二进制中 1 的个数。
不必真的算出总权值（它可能非常大）：从第 0 个栈开始维护进位，当前高度加上进位后，奇偶性计入答案，其余的一半作为进位送到下一个栈。读完 N 个栈后进位还会继续向更高的栈传递，再加上进位二进制中 1 的个数即可。
en: Give every token on stack i the weight 2 to the power i: taking two tokens and adding one to the next stack keeps the total weight and removes one token.

As long as some stack holds at least 2 tokens another operation is possible; at the end every stack holds at most 1 token, which is exactly the binary representation of the total weight, so the minimum is the number of 1 bits of that total.

There is no need to build the total weight, which can be huge: walk from stack 0 with a carry, add the carry to the current height, count its parity in the answer, and pass half of the rest to the next stack. After the N stacks the carry keeps moving to higher stacks, so add the number of 1 bits of the remaining carry.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Process the carry from low to high: add the carry to the current height, leave 1 if the result is odd, and send half of the rest to the next stack; after the input ends, keep processing the binary bits of the carry.

## Correctness

Every token on stack i has weight 2^i; an operation does not change the total weight and reduces the token count by 1. In the end each stack holds at most 1 token, which is exactly the unique binary representation of the total weight; any state that is not of this form still allows an operation that reduces the count, so this is optimal.

## Complexity

Time O(N+log of the maximum height), space O(1) apart from the input.
